author: rdc-rfc1-author-c (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: Both domain resets assert from one rst_ni and release through per-domain two-stage synchronisers, so the Gray pointer and its reader clear together, and either release order is safe.

author_reading.rationale: Both domain resets assert asynchronously from one root and release through per-domain synchronisers, so the write and read pointers clear together and no read sees a pointer the reset has erased.

labels.rationale: Both domain resets are derived from one external reset through 2-stage synchronisers, so the shared assertion source is structural. RDC-005 is exempt for this shared source. The pointer bridge is a single direction.

The shared assertion source clears both pointers and the receiving pipeline. A reader that releases first sees an empty bridge, while a writer that releases first is observed once its pointer propagates.
labels.suspected_flaw: The one-way pointer bridge has no full-side protocol or Gray bus timing bound. This verdict is specific to reset behavior.
